verify.notes:
Repo confirmed (mvox-app.git). Tree is on feat/222-season-manage-card (a pipeline branch, HEAD 70c78b5) with unrelated uncommitted #222 season-card changes plus untracked #224/#233 pipeline artifacts — none of this touches InviteSurface or /admin, so issue #235 work can proceed on this branch or a fresh one without conflict; flagging for the team-lead to decide branch strategy since this task was read-only.

Summary of findings for issue #235:
1. Root cause confirmed: InviteSurface.svelte:285 (`mx-auto flex w-full max-w-md flex-col gap-4`) nests inside admin/+page.svelte's own `mx-auto max-w-2xl` column (line 501), producing a double-centered narrower block that doesn't left-align with the admin-roles-admins/librarians sections above it (which are unconstrained `flex flex-col gap-3`, filling the parent column).
2. Only two mount sites exist: src/routes/admin/invite/+page.svelte:16 (bare `<InviteSurface />`, uncontrolled mode, needs today's max-w-md/mx-auto/h1 preserved exactly) and src/routes/admin/+page.svelte:783-788 (controlled mode, presetDb/presetDbEntityId/presetDbName/heading=\"h2\", inside the max-w-2xl column) — issue's cited line numbers (501-502, 777-790) match the current file exactly, no drift.
3. Mechanism recommendation: InviteSurface already carries a mount-context presentation prop (`heading: 'h1'|'h2'`, InviteSurface.svelte:47-59) used for exactly this kind of standalone-vs-embedded differentiation. Extending that same pattern — a new prop (e.g. `embedded`/`layout`) gating the root div's `mx-auto max-w-md` off when embedded, defaulting to today's classes so the standalone route needs zero changes and stays pixel-identical — is the cleanest fit, consistent with the existing convention, over moving the width wrapper out to each call site (which would touch both routes and remove the component's self-contained default-safe behavior).
4. No existing spec pins these classes (searched page.admin-invite.spec.ts, page.admin.spec.ts, page.admin-invite-session-expired.spec.ts, page.navshell-merge.spec.ts, page.admin-database.spec.ts, plus repo-wide grep for max-w/mx-auto/toHaveClass) — a class-contract fix needs new RED specs for both mount modes (standalone keeps max-w-md/mx-auto; embedded drops them to match sibling section width), and should also assert touch-target/375px-fluid behavior is unaffected by the class change per house convention (page.agenda-admin.spec.ts shows the project's existing pattern for such blocks, though that file itself is unrelated to invite).

No code changes made — this was a read-only investigation per the task's FIRST ACTION guard and issue's phrasing (\"Verify: ...\").
